answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond in escrow before it can transact, with slashing if peers prove duplicate identities. A falcon-fast audit trail links each bond to one verified workload history, so a Sybil farmer at its nadir of cheap identities must fund each fake separately. Like water carving karst, the cost compounds: creating a thousand fakes locks a thousand bonds, while one honest agent pays once.
